title: How Long Should You Study for the Life in the UK Test?
excerpt: Most people need a few weeks. Here's a simple way to know when you're ready.
description: How long to study for the Life in the UK test: a realistic timeline, a simple weekly plan, and the score to aim for before you book.
body:
Most people need a few weeks of regular study to pass the Life in the UK test comfortably. The real answer is simple: study until you pass mock tests with room to spare.

## A realistic timeline

- 1 to 2 weeks: if you already know a lot about UK history and society
- 2 to 4 weeks: for most people, studying a little every day
- Longer: if English isn't your first language or you can only study occasionally

## A simple plan

- Week 1: read the handbook chapters and practise questions by topic
- Week 2: focus on history dates, government and your weakest topics
- Week 3: take a timed mock test every day and review every mistake

## When are you ready?

The pass mark is 18 out of 24. Aim to score 20 or more consistently in mock tests before you book. That gives you a safety margin on the day.
